Town approves harbour restoration plan

The town council approved a restoration plan for the eastern harbour wall during its regular meeting on Tuesday evening. The project will replace damaged stone and reinforce the walkway.

Public works director Maya Chen said crews expect to begin in early November, after the final permits are issued. The work is scheduled to continue for about six weeks, weather permitting.

The council allocated 2.4 million dollars from its coastal infrastructure reserve. Officials said the estimate includes materials, construction, and temporary access improvements for nearby residents.

A pedestrian route will remain open on the western side of the harbour while the eastern section is closed. The town will publish weekly construction updates and post signs at each entrance.

Residents can submit questions through the town website or attend a public information session at the community centre next Thursday. Staff will also share the latest schedule with local businesses.
